title: The New Mathematics of Democracy
abstract: arXiv:2608.16869v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This article surveys emerging directions in the mathematics of democracy. It uses three case studies --- voting theory, participatory budgeting, and deliberative democracy --- to highlight how contemporary challenges motivate rigorous mathematical research that incorporates real-world data, institutional constraints, and implementation feasibility. Within each case, we highlight active and promising research frontiers, evidence of real-world impact, practical applications, and opportunities for getting involved.

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16869v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：本文综述了民主数学中的新兴方向。通过三个案例研究——投票理论、参与式预算和审议民主——来强调当代挑战如何推动融入现实世界数据、制度约束和实施可行性的严谨数学研究。在每个案例中，我们突出了活跃且有前景的研究前沿、现实世界影响的证据、实际应用以及参与机会。
tldr: 本文通过三个案例展示了民主数学如何结合现实数据与制度约束，推动投票、预算和审议领域的前沿研究。
en_tdlr: This article demonstrates how the mathematics of democracy integrates real-world data and institutional constraints to advance frontier research in voting, budgeting, and deliberation.
